entries.label: HOMEWORLD_HELLO_1
entries.body:
It is sure and a true thing that the alien interloper has now been warned
not to approach Caer Zeep-Reep, the Queen's High Perch
lest it be blasted without further warning!
entries.source:
It is sure and a true thing that the alien interloper has now been warned
not to approach Caer Zeep-Reep, the Queen's High Perch
lest it be blasted without further warning!
entries.translation:
外星闖入者如今肯定已經受 到警告
不准接近女王的高棲座凱爾 ・齊普－里普
否則便會在毫無進一步警告 下遭到轟擊！

entries.label: HOMEWORLD_HELLO_2
entries.body:
It is a shocking thing to see the return of the human renegade!
One knows this will not be boding well with her Majesty today.
entries.source:
It is a shocking thing to see the return of the human renegade!
One knows this will not be boding well with her Majesty today.
entries.translation:
人類叛徒竟然回來， 真是令人震驚！
大家都知道，這對女王陛下 今日絕非好兆頭。

entries.label: whats_up_homeworld
entries.body: What has happened in the twenty years since our species last met?
entries.source: What has happened in the twenty years since our species last met?
entries.translation: 貴我兩族上次相遇後的二十 年裡，發生了什麼事？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_HOMEWORLD_1
entries.body:
It is a wondering thought that crosses my mind human starship Captain.
Are ye not knowing that the cause of our Queen and empire
is now allied with the fortunes of the mighty Ur-Quan?...
...and that yer presence here is being only the end of yer life?
Haven't ye got the sense, human, to know this simple thing?
entries.source:
It is a wondering thought that crosses my mind human starship Captain.
Are ye not knowing that the cause of our Queen and empire
is now allied with the fortunes of the mighty Ur-Quan?...
...and that yer presence here is being only the end of yer life?
Haven't ye got the sense, human, to know this simple thing?
entries.translation:
人類星艦船長， 我心裡閃過一個奇怪的念 頭。
難道你不知道， 我們女王與帝國的志業
如今已和強大烏爾關的命運 結盟？……
……而你出現在此， 只會斷送自己的性命？
人類，你連這麼簡單的道理 都不懂嗎？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_HOMEWORLD_2
entries.body:
Ye are asking the words of a mindless child, human!
Here, in the Hall of the Queen's High Perch
ye shall not be finding the sympathies ye so vainly seek.
There are none here but the nobles and battlemasters of the Yehat Clans.
It is a sure thing that we will not be casting flower petals in yer path of rebellion.
entries.source:
Ye are asking the words of a mindless child, human!
Here, in the Hall of the Queen's High Perch
ye shall not be finding the sympathies ye so vainly seek.
There are none here but the nobles and battlemasters of the Yehat Clans.
It is a sure thing that we will not be casting flower petals in yer path of rebellion.
entries.translation:
人類，你問的是無知幼兒才 會說的話！
在這女王高棲座大殿
你找不到自己徒勞尋求的同 情。
這裡只有耶哈特氏族的貴族 與戰鬥大師。
我們絕不會在你的叛亂道路 上灑花瓣。

entries.label: i_demand_you_ally_homeworld0
entries.body: I,
entries.source: I,
entries.translation: 我，

entries.label: i_demand_you_ally_homeworld1
entries.body: , of
entries.source: , of
entries.translation: ，隸屬

entries.label: i_demand_you_ally_homeworld2
entries.body: commanding the
entries.source: commanding the
entries.translation: 指揮

entries.label: i_demand_you_ally_homeworld3
entries.body: , demand that you uphold your duties as allies of the human species!
entries.source: , demand that you uphold your duties as allies of the human species!
entries.translation: ，要求你們履行身為人類盟 友的義務！

entries.label: ENEMY_MUST_DIE
entries.body:
Are ye DAFT human!? Have ye not heard our words?
You and yer kind are slaves, just as we
but you humans have been confined within a shield of slaves!
To be found outside this selfsame shield is surely yer own doom!
It is NOT a permitted thing fer ye to be a-travelling through space
and now, we must be conforming to our Queen's oath to the Ur-Quan.
We must be getting about the business of killing you!
entries.source:
Are ye DAFT human!? Have ye not heard our words?
You and yer kind are slaves, just as we
but you humans have been confined within a shield of slaves!
To be found outside this selfsame shield is surely yer own doom!
It is NOT a permitted thing fer ye to be a-travelling through space
and now, we must be conforming to our Queen's oath to the Ur-Quan.
We must be getting about the business of killing you!
entries.translation:
人類，你瘋了嗎！？ 沒聽見我們的話？
你和你的同類都是奴隸， 就和我們一樣
但你們人類已被禁錮在奴役 護盾內！
出現在這面護盾外， 肯定會為自己招來末日！
你沒有許可在太空旅行
如今我們必須遵守女王對烏 爾關立下的誓言。
我們得開始殺你了！

entries.label: at_least_help_us_homeworld
entries.body: You must help us. Surely you owe us this much, at least!
entries.source: You must help us. Surely you owe us this much, at least!
entries.translation: 你們必須幫助我們。 至少欠我們這麼多吧！

entries.label: NO_HELP_ENEMY
entries.body:
It is an unbelieveable thing!
Ye speak the words that ruffle our feathers and cause our blood to boil!
We, the loyal servants of our Queen, bless her Beak, will not be helping the likes of you
or any of the traitor Yehat bastards ye may have found among the ranks of the starship Clans!
entries.source:
It is an unbelieveable thing!
Ye speak the words that ruffle our feathers and cause our blood to boil!
We, the loyal servants of our Queen, bless her Beak, will not be helping the likes of you
or any of the traitor Yehat bastards ye may have found among the ranks of the starship Clans!
entries.translation:
簡直難以置信！
你說的話令我們羽毛倒豎、 熱血沸騰！
我們是女王忠誠的僕人， 願聖喙庇佑她， 絕不會幫助你這種人
也不會幫助你可能在星艦氏 族行列中找到的任何耶哈特 叛徒混蛋！

entries.label: give_info
entries.body: Surely giving us some scraps of information would be okay, wouldn't it?
entries.source: Surely giving us some scraps of information would be okay, wouldn't it?
entries.translation: 給我們一點零碎情報， 總沒關係吧？

entries.label: NO_INFO_FOR_ENEMY
entries.body:
Our Queen has spoken the commands to us, and we are obeying her words!
No assistance, of any kind at all, shall be given to you, human
so do not be making the assumptions, that ye know a right thing from a wrong!
Are ye smarter than the Queen, is that what yer saying, human?
We shall not be giving ye a SCRAP OF MEAT!... much less our secrets.
entries.source:
Our Queen has spoken the commands to us, and we are obeying her words!
No assistance, of any kind at all, shall be given to you, human
so do not be making the assumptions, that ye know a right thing from a wrong!
Are ye smarter than the Queen, is that what yer saying, human?
We shall not be giving ye a SCRAP OF MEAT!... much less our secrets.
entries.translation:
女王已向我們下令， 我們會服從她的話！
人類，絕不會向你提供任何 形式的協助
所以別自以為你有能力分辨 是非！
你比女王聰明嗎，人類？ 這就是你的意思？
我們一丁點肉屑都不會 給！……更別提祕密。

entries.label: what_about_pkunk_royalist
entries.body: We have encountered an offshoot of your species, the Pkunk. Tell us about them.
entries.source: We have encountered an offshoot of your species, the Pkunk. Tell us about them.
entries.translation: 我們遇見了貴種族的一支旁 系普坎克。說說他們的事。

entries.label: PKUNK_ABSORBED_ROYALIST
entries.body:
The Pkunk have been absorbed.
They are no more. This is how it should be.
Now the matter is settled, human. Do not be bringing it up again...
entries.source:
The Pkunk have been absorbed.
They are no more. This is how it should be.
Now the matter is settled, human. Do not be bringing it up again...
entries.translation:
普坎克已被吸收。
他們不復存在。 本來就該如此。
人類，事情已經了結。 別再提起……

entries.label: HATE_PKUNK_ROYALIST
entries.body:
The cowards live?!! This is unbelievable!!
It is a SAD, SAD day to be hearing this thing from ye, human.
The P... the Pku... I canna even say their vile name!
The Pku... PKU-NK! are the greatest embarrassment our species has ever suffered!
Do not be calling these wretched creatures an offshoot of our species!
Better it is that ye be calling them GARBAGE or DROPPINGS!
Or better yet do not be talking about them at all!
entries.source:
The cowards live?!! This is unbelievable!!
It is a SAD, SAD day to be hearing this thing from ye, human.
The P... the Pku... I canna even say their vile name!
The Pku... PKU-NK! are the greatest embarrassment our species has ever suffered!
Do not be calling these wretched creatures an offshoot of our species!
Better it is that ye be calling them GARBAGE or DROPPINGS!
Or better yet do not be talking about them at all!
entries.translation:
那些懦夫還活著？！！ 簡直難以置信！！
從你口中聽見這件事， 真是悲傷、悲傷的一天， 人類。
普……普坎…… 我連那個卑劣名字都說不出 口！
普坎……普－坎克！ 是我族有史以來最大的恥 辱！
別把這些可悲生物稱為我們 的旁系！
叫他們垃圾或糞便還比較恰 當！
最好根本別提他們！

entries.label: bye_homeworld
entries.body: You disappoint us. We expected more from you. Goodbye.
entries.source: You disappoint us. We expected more from you. Goodbye.
entries.translation: 你令我們失望。 我們原本有更高期待。 再見。

entries.label: GOODBYE_AND_DIE_HOMEWORLD
entries.body:
So human, now ye be thinking that ye shall slink away
to commit some vile treason and dirty our Queen's good name. Isn't this true?
Do not be answering! We know the truth.
We will not let ye pass!
entries.source:
So human, now ye be thinking that ye shall slink away
to commit some vile treason and dirty our Queen's good name. Isn't this true?
Do not be answering! We know the truth.
We will not let ye pass!
entries.translation:
所以人類，你現在想偷偷溜 走
犯下卑劣叛國行為， 玷汙女王的美名。對不對？
不必回答！我們知道真相。
不會讓你通過！

entries.label: SPACE_HELLO_1
entries.body:
What am I seeing on my view screen!?
It is none other than the flattened old face of our friends the human!
But old ally, are ye not knowing that we, the Yehat are allied with the Ur-Quan now?...
and yer presence outside the slave shield, and in an armed starship
are clear violations of yer Oath of Fealty?!
Whatever shall we do? It just isn't a right thing to kill you, human,
but as a loyal member of my Clan, I must obey the wishes of our Queen!
entries.source:
What am I seeing on my view screen!?
It is none other than the flattened old face of our friends the human!
But old ally, are ye not knowing that we, the Yehat are allied with the Ur-Quan now?...
and yer presence outside the slave shield, and in an armed starship
are clear violations of yer Oath of Fealty?!
Whatever shall we do? It just isn't a right thing to kill you, human,
but as a loyal member of my Clan, I must obey the wishes of our Queen!
entries.translation:
我的螢幕上出現了什麼！？
正是老朋友人類那張扁平老 臉！
但老盟友啊，難道你不知 道，我們耶哈特如今已與烏 爾關結盟？……
而你待在奴役護盾外， 又搭乘武裝星艦
顯然違反了效忠誓言？！
我們究竟該怎麼辦？ 殺了你實在不合道義，人類
但身為氏族忠誠一員， 我必須服從女王的意願！

entries.label: SPACE_HELLO_2
entries.body:
Human, what are you doing back here!? Are you totally off yer perch!?
We have sympathies fer yer cause, tis true
but we must obey the orders of our Queen, however much we may disagree with them!
entries.source:
Human, what are you doing back here!? Are you totally off yer perch!?
We have sympathies fer yer cause, tis true
but we must obey the orders of our Queen, however much we may disagree with them!
entries.translation:
人類，你怎麼又回來了！？ 你完全摔下棲木了嗎！？
我們確實同情你的志業
但無論多麼不同意女王的命 令，都必須服從！

entries.label: SPACE_HELLO_3
entries.body:
Human! I am beginning to think that ye are touched, fer sure!
Ye tempt fate and our sympathy too much, I think.
This time, perhaps we cannot be as much yer friends as ye would like.
entries.source:
Human! I am beginning to think that ye are touched, fer sure!
Ye tempt fate and our sympathy too much, I think.
This time, perhaps we cannot be as much yer friends as ye would like.
entries.translation:
人類！我開始認為你肯定瘋 了！
我看你對命運與我們的同 情，都試探得太過火。
這一次，也許我們無法像你 所希望的那樣友善。

entries.label: SPACE_HELLO_4
entries.body:
Human! Human. You try our souls with yer return!
What is it ye be wanting now?
entries.source:
Human! Human. You try our souls with yer return!
What is it ye be wanting now?
entries.translation:
人類！人類。你再度回來， 真是折磨我們的靈魂！
這次又想要什麼？

entries.label: whats_up_space_1
entries.body: We should be allies... friends! Explain why this cannot be.
entries.source: We should be allies... friends! Explain why this cannot be.
entries.translation: 我們應該是盟友…… 是朋友！解釋為何不能如 此。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_SPACE_1
entries.body:
Your words are flying in the face of the facts, human.
We are no longer being your allies.
But unlike the nobles of our homeworld, we, of the Starship Clans
are bereaved at this course of events.
The Queen's decision to be joining the Hierarchy, pains us!
entries.source:
Your words are flying in the face of the facts, human.
We are no longer being your allies.
But unlike the nobles of our homeworld, we, of the Starship Clans
are bereaved at this course of events.
The Queen's decision to be joining the Hierarchy, pains us!
entries.translation:
你的話與事實背道而馳， 人類。
我們已不再是你的盟友。
但我們星艦氏族與母星貴族 不同
對事情發展至此深感悲痛。
女王加入階序的決定令我們 痛苦！

entries.label: whats_up_space_2
entries.body: How did the Ur-Quan defeat you? What happened?
entries.source: How did the Ur-Quan defeat you? What happened?
entries.translation: 烏爾關如何擊敗你們？ 發生了什麼事？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_SPACE_2
entries.body:
WE - WERE - NOT - DEFEATED, HUMAN!!!!
Never! Never in the two-thousand years of the Veep-Neep Queens
have the Yehat ever, EVER suffered a defeat!
It is this fact ALONE that is making our loyalty to the Queen so strong!
This is the unbreakable bond that keeps the Clans together!
When the Ur-Quan were entering our home star system at Gamma Serpentis
we had a thousand starships prepared to defend our home
and then... the Queen... She... she
allied with the Ur-Quan
and the fight is over before it is even begun. AWK!
entries.source:
WE - WERE - NOT - DEFEATED, HUMAN!!!!
Never! Never in the two-thousand years of the Veep-Neep Queens
have the Yehat ever, EVER suffered a defeat!
It is this fact ALONE that is making our loyalty to the Queen so strong!
This is the unbreakable bond that keeps the Clans together!
When the Ur-Quan were entering our home star system at Gamma Serpentis
we had a thousand starships prepared to defend our home
and then... the Queen... She... she
allied with the Ur-Quan
and the fight is over before it is even begun. AWK!
entries.translation:
我們——沒——有——戰 敗，人類！！！！
絕不！維普－尼普女王統治 的兩千年間
耶哈特從未、從未嘗過敗 績！
光是這項事實， 就讓我們如此忠於女王！
正是這條牢不可破的紐帶， 將各氏族維繫在一起！
烏爾關進入我們位於巨蛇座 γ的母星系時
我們準備了一千艘星艦保衛 家園
接著……女王……她……她
與烏爾關結盟了
戰鬥還沒開始就已結束。 嘎！

entries.label: whats_up_space_3
entries.body: What about your legendary honor? Your courage? What would the Shofixti think?!
entries.source: What about your legendary honor? Your courage? What would the Shofixti think?!
entries.translation: 你們傳說中的榮譽呢？ 勇氣呢？索菲克斯提會怎麼 想？！

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_SPACE_3
entries.body:
(sob!)... (whimper) We have fallen so far. (sob!)
We are not being the same (whimper!) great birds of prey your people were once knowing and trusting.
We have each betrayed the honor of our Clan, (whimper!)... just as our Queen
is betraying each of us with her association with the Ur-Quan...
If the valiant child species, the (sob-gulp!)... Shofixti were being here today
the shame!... Oh the shame!... it would be unbearable!
(whimper!)... awk!
entries.source:
(sob!)... (whimper) We have fallen so far. (sob!)
We are not being the same (whimper!) great birds of prey your people were once knowing and trusting.
We have each betrayed the honor of our Clan, (whimper!)... just as our Queen
is betraying each of us with her association with the Ur-Quan...
If the valiant child species, the (sob-gulp!)... Shofixti were being here today
the shame!... Oh the shame!... it would be unbearable!
(whimper!)... awk!
entries.translation:
（啜泣！）…… （嗚咽）我們已墮落得如此 深。（啜泣！）
我們不再是貴種族曾經認識 並信任的（嗚 咽！）偉大猛禽。
我們每一個都背叛了氏族榮 譽，（嗚咽！）…… 正如女王
與烏爾關勾結， 背叛我們每一個……
如果英勇的子民物種（啜泣 吞嚥！）……索菲克斯提今 日還在這裡
這份恥辱！……喔， 這份恥辱！…… 實在令人難以承受！
（嗚咽！）……嘎！

entries.label: whats_up_space_4
entries.body: Aren't you just slaves to the Ur-Quan?
entries.source: Aren't you just slaves to the Ur-Quan?
entries.translation: 你們不就只是烏爾關的奴隸 嗎？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_SPACE_4
entries.body:
NO!  WE ARE NOT SLAVES!! WE ARE!... We are!... we are...
Battle Thralls.
entries.source:
NO!  WE ARE NOT SLAVES!! WE ARE!... We are!... we are...
Battle Thralls.
entries.translation:
不！  我們不是奴隸！！我們 是！……我們是！…… 我們是……
戰奴。

entries.label: i_demand_you_ally_space0
entries.body: By your honor, Yehat captain, I,
entries.source: By your honor, Yehat captain, I,
entries.translation: 以你的榮譽起誓， 耶哈特船長，我，

entries.label: i_demand_you_ally_space1
entries.body: , master of the
entries.source: , master of the
entries.translation: ，身為

entries.label: i_demand_you_ally_space2
entries.body: , in the name of
entries.source: , in the name of
entries.translation: 的艦長，以

entries.label: i_demand_you_ally_space3
entries.body: call upon the Starship Clans to honor their word and fight for our cause!
entries.source: call upon the Starship Clans to honor their word and fight for our cause!
entries.translation: 之名，呼籲星艦氏族信守承 諾，為我們的志業而戰！

entries.label: WE_CANNOT_1
entries.body:
As much as my heart cries to aid ye, valiant human, I cannot!
Each of us is sworn first to our Queen who
has commanded us to treat ye as an enemy of the Crown!
entries.source:
As much as my heart cries to aid ye, valiant human, I cannot!
Each of us is sworn first to our Queen who
has commanded us to treat ye as an enemy of the Crown!
entries.translation:
儘管我的心渴望幫助你， 英勇的人類，但我不能！
我們每一個都首先宣誓效忠 女王，而她
已命令我們把你視為王室之 敵！

entries.label: obligation
entries.body: Your species' obligation cannot simply be forgotten! What about your honor, your pride!?
entries.source: Your species' obligation cannot simply be forgotten! What about your honor, your pride!?
entries.translation: 貴種族的義務不能就這麼忘 掉！你們的榮譽與驕傲 呢！？

entries.label: WE_CANNOT_2
entries.body:
Can't ye see that ye are killing me human?
The shame!... the awful shame of it!
What ye say is true, we SHOULD be under the same wing
but DAMN YER EYES!... our Queen has given the Ur-Quan our allegiance
and there is nothing I can be doing about it now!
entries.source:
Can't ye see that ye are killing me human?
The shame!... the awful shame of it!
What ye say is true, we SHOULD be under the same wing
but DAMN YER EYES!... our Queen has given the Ur-Quan our allegiance
and there is nothing I can be doing about it now!
entries.translation:
人類，你看不出來自己快把 我逼死了嗎？
這份恥辱！…… 可怕的恥辱！
你說得沒錯，我們本該同在 一片羽翼下
但該死的！…… 女王已把忠誠獻給烏爾關
現在我無能為力！

entries.label: at_least_help_us_space
entries.body: At least help us with materials for our struggle!
entries.source: At least help us with materials for our struggle!
entries.translation: 至少提供一些物資， 協助我們奮鬥！

entries.label: SORRY_CANNOT
entries.body:
We cannot!
To be doing so would be a direct violation of our royal Queen's commands!
entries.source:
We cannot!
To be doing so would be a direct violation of our royal Queen's commands!
entries.translation:
不能！
這樣做會直接違反王室女王 的命令！

entries.label: dishonor
entries.body: Think Yehat. The sheer dishonor of it all.
entries.source: Think Yehat. The sheer dishonor of it all.
entries.translation: 想想吧，耶哈特。 這整件事何等不名譽。

entries.label: HERES_A_HINT
entries.body:
We cannot be giving ye material aid, Captain.
But perhaps ye can make use of this information, Captain.
When we were fighting the Great War against the Mycons
we encountered a number of odd worlds which seemed to be having their crust shattered.
Molten lava ran across the surface in huge rivers, and dense metallic elements were abundant.
But the strangest world we found was the first planet at the star at coordinates 639.5 : 231.2.
The Mycons were guarding this planet with an almost limitless number of their Podships
as though there were something of great value there.
We could never break through their forces, though we destroyed scores of their ships.
Perhaps, if ye fare better than us, or can somehow trick the Mycons to let ye land
you may discover this secret, and it may help ye in yer quest.
entries.source:
We cannot be giving ye material aid, Captain.
But perhaps ye can make use of this information, Captain.
When we were fighting the Great War against the Mycons
we encountered a number of odd worlds which seemed to be having their crust shattered.
Molten lava ran across the surface in huge rivers, and dense metallic elements were abundant.
But the strangest world we found was the first planet at the star at coordinates 639.5 : 231.2.
The Mycons were guarding this planet with an almost limitless number of their Podships
as though there were something of great value there.
We could never break through their forces, though we destroyed scores of their ships.
Perhaps, if ye fare better than us, or can somehow trick the Mycons to let ye land
you may discover this secret, and it may help ye in yer quest.
entries.translation:
船長，我們無法提供物資援 助。
但也許這項情報能派上用 場，船長。
我們在大戰中與邁康交戰時
遇見了好幾個奇異世界， 地殼似乎正在碎裂。
熔岩化作巨河流過地表， 還有大量緻密金屬元素。
但最奇異的世界，是座標 639.5 : 231.2 那顆恆星的第一行星。
邁康以近乎無限的孢子艦守 護這顆行星
彷彿那裡有什麼價值極高的 東西。
儘管摧毀了數十艘敵船， 我們仍無法突破其部隊。
也許你能比我們做得更好， 或設法騙過邁康，讓你降落
便可能發現這項祕密， 而它也許有助於你的任務。

entries.label: what_about_pkunk_space
entries.body: Tell us about the Pkunk.
entries.source: Tell us about the Pkunk.
entries.translation: 談談普坎克。

entries.label: PKUNK_ABSORBED_SPACE
entries.body:
This is a matter for the Yehat, human, and ONLY for the Yehat.
The Pkunk have been absorbed... and that is being the end of it.
Do not ask further about this matter.
entries.source:
This is a matter for the Yehat, human, and ONLY for the Yehat.
The Pkunk have been absorbed... and that is being the end of it.
Do not ask further about this matter.
entries.translation:
這是耶哈特自己的事， 人類，而且只關乎耶哈特。
普坎克已被吸收…… 事情就此結束。
別再追問。

entries.label: HATE_PKUNK_SPACE
entries.body:
You have met them!?? The wretched creatures are alive?!!
You should be telling us where they are, Captain!
Tell us so that we can be correcting the mistake made a thousand years ago
when we permitted the Pkunk to leave our Nest alive.
By all rights, we should have eliminated the craven cowards down to the last bird!
entries.source:
You have met them!?? The wretched creatures are alive?!!
You should be telling us where they are, Captain!
Tell us so that we can be correcting the mistake made a thousand years ago
when we permitted the Pkunk to leave our Nest alive.
By all rights, we should have eliminated the craven cowards down to the last bird!
entries.translation:
你見過他們！？ 那些可悲生物還活著？！！
你應該告訴我們他們在哪 裡，船長！
快說，好讓我們糾正一千年 前的錯誤
當時竟然讓普坎克活著離開 我們的巢。
按理說，我們應該把那些懦 夫殺到一鳥不剩！

entries.label: bye_space
entries.body: Goodbye Yehat... our allies and friends.
entries.source: Goodbye Yehat... our allies and friends.
entries.translation: 再見，耶哈特…… 我們的盟友與朋友。

entries.label: GO_IN_PEACE
entries.body:
Though honoring our past commitment we are not,
we will be letting you go in peace.
entries.source:
Though honoring our past commitment we are not,
we will be letting you go in peace.
entries.translation:
儘管沒有履行過去的承諾
我們仍會讓你和平離去。

entries.label: GOODBYE_AND_DIE_SPACE
entries.body:
You are causing us sorrow, human, sorrow indeed,
because now we must obey the commands of our Queen and destroy you.
entries.source:
You are causing us sorrow, human, sorrow indeed,
because now we must obey the commands of our Queen and destroy you.
entries.translation:
人類，你令我們悲傷， 確實悲傷
因為現在必須服從女王命 令，摧毀你。

entries.label: shofixti_alive_1
entries.body: This may come as a shock, but the Shofixti are reborn.
entries.source: This may come as a shock, but the Shofixti are reborn.
entries.translation: 你可能會很震驚， 但索菲克斯提重生了。

entries.label: shofixti_alive_2
entries.body: We have a Shofixti Captain here with us. Now do you believe?
entries.source: We have a Shofixti Captain here with us. Now do you believe?
entries.translation: 這裡有一位索菲克斯提船長 與我們同行。現在相信了 嗎？

entries.label: SEND_HIM_OVER_1
entries.body:
If this is being a true thing, there will be many changes.
But we are a species long wise in the ways of deceit.
Ye must be proving these words ye say, Captain.
Send the Shofixti to us as a way of proof.
entries.source:
If this is being a true thing, there will be many changes.
But we are a species long wise in the ways of deceit.
Ye must be proving these words ye say, Captain.
Send the Shofixti to us as a way of proof.
entries.translation:
如果這是真的， 許多事情都會改變。
但我族長久以來深諳欺詐之 道。
你必須證明自己的話， 船長。
把索菲克斯提送過來作為證 明。

entries.label: SEND_HIM_OVER_2
entries.body:
Ye are lying to us once, Captain. Now we need the hard evidence.
Order yer supposed Shofixti to come to us, Captain.
entries.source:
Ye are lying to us once, Captain. Now we need the hard evidence.
Order yer supposed Shofixti to come to us, Captain.
entries.translation:
船長，你已經騙過我們一 次。現在需要確鑿證據。
命令你所謂的索菲克斯提前 來，船長。

entries.label: not_here
entries.body: Well I don't have one right HERE.
entries.source: Well I don't have one right HERE.
entries.translation: 嗯，我現在手邊沒有。

entries.label: not_send
entries.body: I will not subject one of my officers to such danger. How do I know you won't just kill him?
entries.source: I will not subject one of my officers to such danger. How do I know you won't just kill him?
entries.translation: 我不會讓麾下軍官冒這種 險。我怎知道你不會直接殺 了他？

entries.label: JUST_A_TRICK_1
entries.body:
It is a trick then, isn't it! And nothing more.
Human, we have been patient with ye up to this point, but now ye have gone too far.
Ye have most skillfully rubbed the salt into our wounds, and ye shall pay fer it in blood!
entries.source:
It is a trick then, isn't it! And nothing more.
Human, we have been patient with ye up to this point, but now ye have gone too far.
Ye have most skillfully rubbed the salt into our wounds, and ye shall pay fer it in blood!
entries.translation:
所以這是詭計，對不對！ 除此之外什麼也不是。
人類，到目前為止， 我們一直耐心對待你， 但你已經太過分。
你手法高明地在傷口上撒 鹽，必將以鮮血付出代價！

entries.label: JUST_A_TRICK_2
entries.body:
Another TRICK!
Yer lying tongue has doomed ye!
entries.source:
Another TRICK!
Yer lying tongue has doomed ye!
entries.translation:
又一場詭計！
你說謊的舌頭注定害死自 己！

entries.label: ok_send
entries.body: All right, I'll send over the Shofixti... but don't mess with him, okay?
entries.source: All right, I'll send over the Shofixti... but don't mess with him, okay?
entries.translation: 好吧，我把索菲克斯提送過 去……但別對他亂來， 好嗎？

entries.label: WE_REVOLT
entries.body:
We are scanning the separation of a vessel from yer fleet, Captain
and indeed, its configuration matches that of a Shofixti Scout vessel.
This had better not be a trick, Captain!
We are knowing the power of a Glory Device, and if you detonate the weapon near us
the price for you shall be dear, very dear.
The Scout has docked, and we await the pilot's appearance at the airlock.
The atmosphere cycle is complete... the door slides open... and
IT IS TRUE!!! THE SHOFIXTI ARE ALIVE!!!
Look at that furred muzzle, those shining black eyes, the sweet claws!
Our children have returned from oblivion!!
But now we are faced with the cruellest truth!...
...We who have sacrificed our honor! We who have lain with the enemy!
WE ARE NOT WORTHY! WE ARE NOTHING!...We are less than nothing.
But wait! We are not Spathi. We are Yehat... OF THE STARSHIP CLANS!
We will NOT live this lie any longer!
Listen as I speak these words! If our Queen makes the dishonorable command
then it is THE QUEEN WHO HAS NO HONOR!
And a dishonorable Queen is NO QUEEN AT ALL!
We, the Zeep-Zeep, are the only Clan who remember the TRUE MEANING of honor
we shall TEAR THE QUEEN FROM HER THRONE!
The two-thousand year reign of the Veep-Neep Queens IS OVER!
THE REVOLUTION HAS BEGUN!

entries.translation:
船長，我們正掃描到一艘船 脫離你的艦隊
沒錯，外形與索菲克斯提偵 察艦相符。
船長，這最好不是詭計！
我們知道榮光裝置的威力； 若你在附近引爆武器
便會付出慘痛、 無比慘痛的代價。
偵察艦已停靠， 我們等著駕駛員出現在氣閘 口。
大氣循環完成…… 艙門滑開……而
是真的！！！索菲克斯提還 活著！！！
看看那毛茸茸的口鼻、 閃亮黑眼睛、可愛利爪！
我們的孩子從湮滅中歸來 了！！
但現在我們面對最殘酷的真 相！……
……我們犧牲了榮譽！ 我們與敵人同床共枕！
我們不配！我們什麼都不 是！……比什麼都不是還不 如。
但等一下！我們不是斯帕 西。我們是耶哈特…… 是星艦氏族！
再也不會活在這場謊言裡！
聽我說！如果女王下達不名 譽的命令
那麼沒有榮譽的就是女王！
不名譽的女王， 根本不配為王！
我們齊普－齊普， 是唯一記得榮譽真正意義的 氏族
我們要把女王拉下王座！
維普－尼普女王兩千年的統 治結束了！
革命已經開始！

entries.label: ROYALIST_SPACE_HELLO_1
entries.body:
Human... ye shall never be fully comprehending the damage you are doing now to our Yehat culture.
For fully TWO THOUSAND YEARS there has been peace between the Clans!...
...and now you have cast the ancient seed of dissension between our beaks!
The bloody Wars of Ascension are renewed, and YOU are the cause, Captain!
While the Zeep-Zeep traitors may be your allies, Captain
I can be assuring you that we, of the Feep-Eeep Starship Clan
are wanting nothing more dearly than your death!
entries.source:
Human... ye shall never be fully comprehending the damage you are doing now to our Yehat culture.
For fully TWO THOUSAND YEARS there has been peace between the Clans!...
...and now you have cast the ancient seed of dissension between our beaks!
The bloody Wars of Ascension are renewed, and YOU are the cause, Captain!
While the Zeep-Zeep traitors may be your allies, Captain
I can be assuring you that we, of the Feep-Eeep Starship Clan
are wanting nothing more dearly than your death!
entries.translation:
人類……你永遠無法完全理 解，現在對耶哈特文化造成 了多大傷害。
氏族之間和平了整整兩千 年！……
……如今你卻在我們尖喙之 間，播下古老的分裂種子！
血腥的登位戰爭重新爆發， 而你就是起因，船長！
齊普－齊普叛徒也許是你的 盟友，船長
但我可以向你保證， 我們菲普－伊普星艦氏族
最深切盼望的， 就是你的死亡！

entries.label: ROYALIST_SPACE_HELLO_2
entries.body:
It is the human Agitator who would see Her Radiant Majesty pulled from the High Perch!
Ye will rue the day ye devised this wicked scheme!
entries.source:
It is the human Agitator who would see Her Radiant Majesty pulled from the High Perch!
Ye will rue the day ye devised this wicked scheme!
entries.translation:
就是這個人類煽動者， 想把光輝女王陛下拉下高棲 座！
你會為想出這項邪惡計畫的 那天後悔！

entries.label: ROYALIST_HOMEWORLD_HELLO_1
entries.body:
Human! Like all heroes, ye be as brainless as ye are brave.
Do ye not know, that here there be none of the traitorous Zeep-Zeep Starship Clans!
Ye are as good as dead, human.
entries.source:
Human! Like all heroes, ye be as brainless as ye are brave.
Do ye not know, that here there be none of the traitorous Zeep-Zeep Starship Clans!
Ye are as good as dead, human.
entries.translation:
人類！和所有英雄一樣， 你的愚蠢與英勇不相上下。
難道不知道，這裡沒有任何 叛變的齊普－齊普星艦氏 族！
人類，你死定了。

entries.label: ROYALIST_HOMEWORLD_HELLO_2
entries.body:
Cease yer bloody taunting, human!
Ye dance like a sick breeg, never engaging us in battle-to-the-death
as honor and true courage are demanding!
entries.source:
Cease yer bloody taunting, human!
Ye dance like a sick breeg, never engaging us in battle-to-the-death
as honor and true courage are demanding!
entries.translation:
停止你那血淋淋的挑釁， 人類！
你跳得像隻生病的布里格， 從不與我們進行生死決戰
儘管榮譽與真正勇氣都要求 你這樣做！

entries.label: how_is_rebellion
entries.body: So, how's the revolution going for you guys?
entries.source: So, how's the revolution going for you guys?
entries.translation: 所以，你們的革命進展如 何？

entries.label: ROYALIST_REBELLION_1
entries.body:
Revolution!? Ye compliment yerself unnecessarily, Captain.
This is nothing more than a... band of thugs trying to undo the peace of a hundred generations!
We will roast the traitors in their ships, and crack the eggs in their Clanhome
so that never again will the Zeep-Zeep criminals be flying though our stars.
entries.source:
Revolution!? Ye compliment yerself unnecessarily, Captain.
This is nothing more than a... band of thugs trying to undo the peace of a hundred generations!
We will roast the traitors in their ships, and crack the eggs in their Clanhome
so that never again will the Zeep-Zeep criminals be flying though our stars.
entries.translation:
革命！？船長， 你太抬舉自己了。
這不過是……一群暴徒企圖 推翻上百世代的和平！
我們會把叛徒連船一起烤 熟，砸爛他們氏族家園的蛋
讓齊普－齊普罪犯再也無法 飛過我們的群星。

entries.label: ROYALIST_REBELLION_2
entries.body: Do not be worrying yerself, Captain! Victory is almost within our grasp.
entries.source: Do not be worrying yerself, Captain! Victory is almost within our grasp.
entries.translation: 不用擔心，船長！ 勝利已近在眼前。

entries.label: sorry_about_revolution
entries.body: Gosh, I'm sorry about this revolution thing. I didn't mean any harm.
entries.source: Gosh, I'm sorry about this revolution thing. I didn't mean any harm.
entries.translation: 天啊，這場革命的事我很抱 歉。我沒有惡意。

entries.label: ALL_YOUR_FAULT
entries.body:
The pain and suffering of this useless conflict are being nothing but a tragic waste of life.
Congratulate yourself, Captain. The source of all this death and misery is yerself.
entries.source:
The pain and suffering of this useless conflict are being nothing but a tragic waste of life.
Congratulate yourself, Captain. The source of all this death and misery is yerself.
entries.translation:
這場無謂衝突帶來的痛苦折 磨，只是生命的悲劇性浪 費。
恭喜自己吧，船長。 所有死亡與苦難的源頭就是 你。

entries.label: bye_royalist
entries.body: Goodbye Royalist fool!
entries.source: Goodbye Royalist fool!
entries.translation: 再見，保王派蠢材！

entries.label: GOODBYE_AND_DIE_ROYALIST
entries.body: Now ye must pay fer yer crimes, human!
entries.source: Now ye must pay fer yer crimes, human!
entries.translation: 現在你得為罪行付出代價， 人類！

entries.label: name_1
entries.body: The New Alliance of Free Stars
entries.source: The New Alliance of Free Stars
entries.translation: 新自由星辰聯盟

entries.label: name_2
entries.body: The Concordance of Alien Nations
entries.source: The Concordance of Alien Nations
entries.translation: 外星國家協約

entries.label: name_3
entries.body: The United Federation of Worlds
entries.source: The United Federation of Worlds
entries.translation: 世界聯合聯邦

entries.label: name_40
entries.body: The Empire of
entries.source: The Empire of
entries.translation: 帝國，國號為

entries.label: OUT_TAKES
entries.body:
So, I suppose you are wondering what I'm doing at this control console
well, I guess I can tell you now.
I'm writing a screenplay!
It's an existential thriller!
Kind of a cross between a Woody Allen angst-fest mixed with some of Tobe Hooper's best work.
But actually, this is just my way of getting my wing in the door, you see
what I really want to do is DIRECT!
entries.source:
So, I suppose you are wondering what I'm doing at this control console
well, I guess I can tell you now.
I'm writing a screenplay!
It's an existential thriller!
Kind of a cross between a Woody Allen angst-fest mixed with some of Tobe Hooper's best work.
But actually, this is just my way of getting my wing in the door, you see
what I really want to do is DIRECT!
entries.translation:
所以，我想你很想知道我在 這座控制台做什麼
嗯，現在可以告訴你了。
我在寫劇本！
這是一部存在主義驚悚片！
有點像 Woody Allen 的焦慮大會，混上 Tobe Hooper 的幾部傑作。
但其實，這只是我先把翅膀 卡進門縫的方法，你瞧
我真正想做的是當導演！
